description: Blixtsensordata - realtid is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by opendata.smhi.se. The service delivers information about lightning discharges in Sweden. When a lightning discharge has occurred and the information has reached SMHI, the information is delivered via push technology via web-sockets until those who use the service. To interpret the raw sensor data, the consumer needs a so-called "Total Lightning Processor, TLP". Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Lightning sensor data - real-time" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2024-04-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
